Definition: probably akin to the base of G3686; notoriety, i.e. a taunt (disgrace):--reproach.
BiblicalUsage: Oneidos is reproach, a taunt, a disgrace. It occurs once, in Luke 1:25, where Elizabeth says the Lord has looked on her to take away her reproach among men, after years of barrenness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God takes away reproach in His own time, and Elizabeth's child is the proof that no disgrace lasts for ever.
RelatedEvents: The Birth of John the Baptist
